sections.description: One status dashboard and a standard set of fixes for the SEO and AI optimization basics on Vinbound-managed sites: business schema, alt text, meta descriptions, H1s, titles, bot access, FAQs, and mobile zoom. Works alongside Yoast SEO or Rank Math.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Indexing & Visibility: a core page (on the FAQ Tracker list or in the main menu) that is set to noindex is now a problem, named first on the Dashboard.
  • Indexing & Visibility: carts, checkouts, and account pages that can be indexed are listed, along with pages whose address reads like a test, a copy, or an older version. Both can be set to noindex through Yoast SEO or Rank Math from the list, after a tick to confirm, and shown again later. Each page is read again afterwards and the message says what it now delivers.
  • Indexing & Visibility: thin pages, counted from the HTML the site sends. The limit (200 words to start with) is under Settings.
  • Indexing & Visibility: the XML sitemap is checked. Listed: no sitemap, a robots.txt that does not point to it, template and media files in it, addresses in another form than the site's own, noindexed pages, and carts or account pages.
  • Indexing & Visibility: the other forms of the site address (http, and with or without www) are tested to see that each leads to the site.
  • Business Schema: blocks that cannot be read, a star rating the business publishes about itself, profile links that are not full addresses, Article schema on pages that are not articles, and a site name that differs from the business name.
  • Bot Access: Crawl-delay lines are listed and can be taken out, with a backup and an undo.
  • New tab and Dashboard card: Accounts & Listings, a checklist for Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, Google Analytics 4, and Google Business Profile.
  • A noindexed cart, checkout, or account page is no longer listed "to confirm".

1.0.1

  • Commerce7 pages (store, product, club, and account pages) are recognized, listed for reference, and left out of the meta description, title, and H1 counts.
  • The scan reads a fresh copy of each page instead of a cached one. After the zoom fix is switched on or off, the plugin clears the caches it can reach and reports whether visitors are already getting the new page.
  • The scheduled scan is skipped when a scan finished within the last hour.
  • Settings: choose which content types the scan counts, and leave out addresses by rule (for example /qr/*). Event venue and organizer pages start out left out.
  • FAQ Tracker: better suggestions for the core pages. Pages hidden from search and Commerce7 pages are never suggested, and pages where the scan saw an FAQ are offered for the list.
  • Business Profile: "Fill empty fields from the schema on the homepage" reads a business schema block that is already on the site and names every part the profile has no field for. The Dashboard points at such a block while the profile still has empty fields. The second-business-block finding names the block, says where it comes from, and counts every page that carries it.
  • Dashboard: "Start here" lists what is wrong on the homepage and the core pages. Findings lists show the homepage first, then core pages.
  • Other plugins' notices no longer show on the plugin's own screens.
  • The Dashboard asks for a rescan when the last scan was made by an earlier version of the plugin.

1.0.0

  • First release: dashboard, page scan, Business Profile and schema, findings with CSV export, Bot Access with guarded robots.txt and .htaccess changes, FAQ Tracker, mobile zoom fix, Activity Log, access rule, and updates through the WordPress Updates screen.
